description: Frozen-source journal tables; no training or inference

certificate_table.certificate_type: Theorems 1/2 bounded-loss Gibbs population risk, with theorem/setup-union and fresh-MC confidence

empirical_gibbs_mc.posterior_rule: one weight draw fixed across entire loader per replicate
empirical_gibbs_mc.mc_note: Finite-data Gibbs Monte Carlo estimates, not population-risk certificates

channel_shift.status: exact feature-erasure total variation for bounded loss
channel_shift.theory_basis: Uniform [0,1] bounded-loss total-variation inequality; additional to the draft's Wasserstein formulation

certificate_table.bound_selection: Minimum of two simultaneously valid theorem bounds, using one shared fresh MC evaluation

candidate_family.description: Declared mechanism n/m/bank-seed family only; other architectures and search campaigns excluded

scope: Bound concerns expected normalized smooth loss over posterior weights and fresh deployment data/channels.
It is not a direct numerical upper bound on classification error, unbounded CE, or each sampled deployed network.
Conditional on correctness of the supplied Theorems 1/2 and their IID/data-independent-prior assumptions; their proofs are not verified by this numerical calculation.
Declared setup count must include every considered data/channel-bank, sample-size and training-law setup with the fixed prior, architecture and loss.
Uniformity over the posterior permits algorithm/hyperparameter/initialization selection within each covered setup without another algorithm multiplicity factor.
The checkpoint must be selected before this fresh certificate Monte Carlo stream; selecting among repeated MC certificates needs another union allocation.

conventions.uncertainty: sample SD across initialization/channel-bank seeds, conditional on fixed dataset
conventions.proposed_perfect_alias: Source PAC-Perfect is the exact proposed perfect-channel specialization
conventions.missing: L2 Perfect absent from the new protocol; no synthetic or legacy substitution
